seo.title: Melusina Roadmap | Trust Chain, Threshold Crypto & Sovereign Infrastructure
seo.description: Track Melusina's implementation milestones: Solana program deployment, NFT trust hierarchy, threshold cryptography, DANE/DNSSEC, and Pearl orchestration.
seo.keywords: melusina roadmap, trust chain milestones, threshold crypto timeline, NFT licensing progress

hero.heading: Building verifiable infrastructure in the open
hero.subtitle: Every milestone produces on-chain artifacts. Progress you can verify — not promises you have to trust.

items.title: Solana Program & Foundation NFT
items.description: Deploy the Melusina License Registry program on Solana. Mint the Foundation Master NFT. Establish the root of the hierarchical trust chain.
deliverables: License Registry program deployed (8bVLhPF9suNrB3Tj5q9Ps6uyonhWxeTUpXTyDRwitnR9)
Foundation Master NFT minted with metadata URI
Reseller NFT minting instruction operational
License NFT minting under reseller authority
Keyholder registration with X25519 public keys

items.title: Shamir SSS & Keyholder Ops
items.description: Implement threshold cryptography layer: Shamir secret sharing over GF(256), NaCl SealedBox per-keyholder encryption, and M-of-N Vault unseal.
deliverables: Shamir SSS implementation over GF(256)
NaCl SealedBox encryption per keyholder X25519 key
Threshold Vault unseal (M-of-N keyholders)
Threshold-encrypted backup system
Keyholder share distribution and rotation

items.title: 4-Phase Boot Orchestration
items.description: Blockchain-coordinated boot sequence: license verification, monitoring setup, threshold Vault unseal, and service start. No service runs without on-chain confirmation.
deliverables: Phase 1: License NFT verification via Solana RPC
Phase 2: Monitoring and alerting provisioned
Phase 3: Threshold keyholder Vault unseal
Phase 4: Service startup with derived ephemeral CA keys
DANE TLSA record publishing in DNSSEC-signed zones

items.title: On-Chain Billing & Pearl Escrow
items.description: SOL-denominated billing with on-chain payment verification via getTransaction(). Pearl-based metered billing with escrow and settlement.
deliverables: SOL payment verification via getTransaction()
Tier-based cloud plans (Starter → Enterprise in SOL)
Per-Pearl SOL micropayment wallets with escrow
Pearl spend limits and preauthorization thresholds
Automated license suspension on payment lapse
Payment history on-chain via Memo transactions

items.title: Sovereign Pearl Isolation & AI Pearls
items.description: Full Pearl lifecycle orchestration with Incus containers, capability-based access control, and isolated AI Pearls for local model inference.
deliverables: Pearl provisioning via Incus container orchestration
Capability-based access control
Pearl-blind shared OTP: platform-level codes with HMAC proof tokens, Pearl never sees the code
Shared notification stack: email, SMS, Telegram via Grapple capability grants
AI Pearl isolation — local LLMs with no network egress
Pearl-level backup with threshold encryption
Recallable Admin NFT integration per Pearl

items.title: PWA, Wallet Auth & Pearl Creation
items.description: Progressive Web App with content-free push, 3-tier Solana wallet authentication, and policy-gated Pearl-creates-Pearl workflow.
deliverables: PWA manifest and service worker with offline access
Content-free push notifications (empty payloads, DDP-aware)
3-tier wallet login: extension / Mobile Wallet Adapter / QR code
Keyholder NFT → auto-admin promotion with 5-minute cache
Policy-gated Pearl-creates-Pearl with approval popup
Four Pearl link modes: burn-after-reading, timed, use-count, unlimited
NFT-backed Pearl shares via Solana PDA

items.title: Mermail, Solana Proxy & Cyclone
items.description: Deploy production sidelying services: Mermail email gateway, rate-limited Solana RPC proxy, and Cyclone multi-machine clustering. Internal mTLS between all containers.
deliverables: Mermail email gateway (Go, Postmark + SMTP failover, DKIM, SRS, SQLite queue)
Solana RPC proxy (47 whitelisted methods, rate limiting, key injection)
Cyclone cluster orchestration (C++, Cap'n Proto schema)
Internal mTLS via threshold-derived CA between all containers
TrustMaster external verification tool
Cap'n Proto dual transport (native + postMessage bridging)
